name: 3way
turns: Thank you for calling Meridian Voice Support, this is Priya. How can I help you today?
Hi Priya, it's Tom Becker at Lakeside Dental. We're moving our fax line to you from our old carrier, and the port date keeps getting pushed back.
Let me check. I see the port request, and it was rejected by the old carrier twice. Marcus on our porting team has been working on it.
Can I talk to him? I'd like to understand what's going wrong.
Of course. I'll set up a three-way call so all three of us can go over it together. One moment.
Tom, you're in the conference. Marcus is joining now.
Okay, I'm here. Thanks for doing this.
No problem. It can take a few seconds for him to connect.
Hi Tom, hi Priya, Marcus here. Tom, I have your port request open.
The old carrier says the account number on the form doesn't match their records. They have it ending in four four one two.
We wrote four four one two one. I think we added a digit.
That explains it. I'll correct it and resubmit today. The new port date should be next Thursday.
I'll add a note to your ticket with the new date, Tom.
You'll get an email when it completes. Have a good day, Tom.
